page.layout: One printed page. Running head "MATERIARUM" centred at top. Two columns of short summary lines, paragraph numbers (§) as section headings in each column; left column first, then right column. Signature-like marks at foot: "**** 2" left, "2. Li-" right (catchword).

main_text.l: 3. Aliqua tamen in re & verbis superest differentia.
2. Quædam res, & facta legari non possunt.
3. Ubi legatum rei prorsus est inutile ibi ne quidem debetur æstimatio.
4. Casu quo statutum prohibet immobilia legari, nec debebitur æstimatio.
5. Idem quod in feudo legato obtinet.
main_text.p: Res obligata recte legatur, & quis eam luat, explicatur.
main_text.l: 1. Rei quæ facta est legatarii, legatum valet.
2. Eadem quantitas multoties relicta, forte nonnisi semel debebitur.
main_text.p: Quod non est, legari quandoque potest.
Fundi proprietas sola legari potest, & quid obtineat illo casu.
Res legatarii quandoque ei legari potest.
main_text.l: 1. Creditori quod debet testator legare potest.
2. Non tamen si debitor certam quantitatem leget creditori, compensandi animus præsumitur.

page.notes: Printed in two columns; the layout of section numbers is reconstructed. Some words are doubtful in the scan, notably "adimum" (likely "adimi") and "Liberatio legari potest" (possibly "legari"). Page is a contents/summary page of the book's material index.
